semanticsSource: Julius's reported requirements: connected arms, credible grips, no prop/furniture clipping, private cards, cozy Christmas lighting, block props, compact drink ordering and smooth performance

cases.events: drink accepted at visual 17.7207 and 31.1354 seconds
cases.evidence: At visual 31.8281, right wrist world [1.086105,0.711337,0.517719], camera distance 1.988202m. Screenshot 18.065 shows disconnected hand at table. Hero has only a wrist-parented short sleeve, no shoulder/elbow chain.
cases.expected: Reachable drink/ashtray homes and a connected shoulder-elbow-wrist chain. Resolve prop and wrist in one frame. Do not silently clamp wrist while prop continues independently.

cases.evidence: During attached sip phases the authored hand/glass anchors agree to 4.8e-16m. The visible reach is still wrong: a contact-equality test alone would bless this bug.
cases.expected: Contact constraints AND reachable connected body geometry; both must pass.

cases.events: Pause at visual 31.6271, resume after 5.4165s wall time at same visual time, inspection at 31.9255, look up at 38.8493
cases.evidence: Pause correctly freezes visual time. Inspection cancels directly to homes, without an explicit return phase; cigar request at 39.1742 is rejected during residual inspection blend although the UI button is enabled.
cases.expected: Pause preserves pose; inspection has an explicit safe interruption/return policy and UI availability matches interaction availability.

cases.evidence: Actual pre-batching tree AABB [2.235315,-0.002,-4.375988,4.084685,2.45,-2.524012] intersects recorded bar body, panels, counter and foot rail. Seven block-envelope overlaps. No side/back-wall overlap in this recorded camera/layout; user's broader wall report remains an additional clearance requirement.
cases.expected: Tree including branches/ornaments/presents has positive furniture/wall clearance, verified against production geometry. AABBs are conservative, not proof that every overlapping envelope is a triangle intersection.

cases.evidence: Front/side/top views show a dark U-shaped slab separated from the rounded jaw. The current beard volume adds a rectangular shell rather than coloring/sculpting the actual facial surface.
cases.expected: Restrained facial hair follows the jaw/upper-lip surface, without floating edges or squared-off cheek growth.

cases.evidence: Finger envelopes look like thin angular ribbons at bends; cigar is balanced across fingers instead of convincingly pinched. Existing no-paper-intersection test is not anatomy/contact signoff. Inspect greedy mesh T-junctions under skinning before adding more volume.
cases.expected: Closed, connected, naturally proportioned finger surfaces through bending; stable visible support/pinch without paper/cigar penetration.

cases.evidence: 2133x1166 CSS viewport, 2666x1458 drawing buffer, DPR cap 1.25: frame p50 36ms/p95 56ms; CPU submission p50 6.9ms/p95 9.4ms. Screenshots and diagnostics add overhead; GPU time not measured.
cases.expected: Measure comparable uninstrumented and instrumented warm runs, identify CPU/GPU/resource bottlenecks, preserve visual quality while approaching a stable 16.7ms frame budget on this machine.
